title: QUIC Advisory Peer Characterization Matrix Pilot Verification
verification_method: Requirement-home tests, helper dry-run planning, artifact inspection, and hosted workflow dispatch when external evidence is required.
preconditions: The major-peer-matrix and connectionmigration workflow profiles remain advisory and available.
Captured connectionmigration and comparison bundles remain available for inspection.
The repo-local helper can run in dry-run mode and enumerate per-cell rows.
The generated peer-characterization pilot report is present in the repository.
The generated major-peer matrix inventory report is present in the repository.
The generated major-peer matrix evidence report is present in the repository.
scope: Verify that the repository can characterize mixed peer outcomes by peer, role, testcase, outcome class, failure class, and artifact root without collapsing them into a single green/red verdict, using the current major-peer matrix and connectionmigration lanes as the pilot surfaces.
procedure: Review `docs/current-status.md`, `specs/requirements/quic/REQUIREMENT-GAPS.md`, and the interop workflow/helper docs to confirm the matrix remains advisory.
Inspect the preserved connectionmigration proof bundles and the blocked comparison bundle to confirm heterogeneous failure classes stay visible.
Run helper dry-run or summary tests that validate `neqo-peer` reporting while the actual runner slot remains normalized to `neqo`.
Confirm the matrix report shape carries peer, role, testcase, outcome class, failure class, and artifact root per cell.
Inspect the generated advisory pilot report under `specs/generated/quic/interop-peer-characterization-matrix-pilot.json` and `.md`.
Inspect the generated advisory major-peer inventory report under `specs/generated/quic/interop-major-peer-matrix-inventory.json` and `.md`.
Inspect the generated advisory major-peer evidence report under `specs/generated/quic/interop-major-peer-matrix-evidence-25904716076.json` and `.md`.
Run the focused requirement-home tests for `REQ-QUIC-INT-0019` and `REQ-QUIC-INT-0022`.
When external evidence is required, dispatch a hosted comparison run and inspect the preserved runner-report, qlog, and stderr logs.
expected_result: The repository can describe and verify a peer-characterization matrix that preserves mixed interop outcomes for investigation instead of flattening them to green/red.
status_summary: Planned. The matrix pilot now combines the seeded connectionmigration rows with the current major-peer evidence so mixed comparison results can be classified by peer, role, testcase, failure class, and artifact root instead of being flattened to green/red. Hosted comparison evidence now includes completed major-peer run `25904716076`, which produced mixed peer-specific results rather than one Incursa regression vector, and the repository now has a generated advisory pilot report `interop-peer-characterization-matrix-pilot`, a generated major-peer inventory report `interop-major-peer-matrix-inventory`, a generated major-peer evidence report `interop-major-peer-matrix-evidence-25904716076`, and a test-side row projector, but broader matrix refresh work is still advisory.

supplemental_sections.heading: Scope
supplemental_sections.content: This verification only covers the advisory characterization overlay. It does not claim new peer support, and it does not turn the matrix into a blocking CI gate.
